text: [HOSTEL CURFEW & ENTRY RULES] (hostel): All hostel residents must return to the hostel premises by 9:30 PM on weekdays and 10:00 PM on weekends. Late entry requires prior written permission from the hostel warden. Gate access is restricted after curfew.

[HOSTEL MESS TIMINGS & MENU RULES] (hostel): Mess operating hours: Breakfast 7:30 AM - 9:30 AM, Lunch 12:30 PM - 2:30 PM, Evening Snacks 5:00 PM - 6:00 PM, Dinner 7:30 PM - 9:30 PM. The mess closes strictly at 9:30 PM. Outside food delivery is allowed in common dining areas only.

[HOSTEL GUEST POLICY] (hostel): Day visitors and family members are allowed in the visitor lounge between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM. No overnight guests are allowed in student rooms without prior warden approval. Bringing unauthorized guests to rooms results in a fine.

[HOSTEL ROOM MAINTENANCE & ELECTRIC APPLIANCES] (hostel): Students are responsible for room cleanliness. High wattage electrical appliances such as heaters, induction stoves, and iron boxes are strictly prohibited in hostel rooms. Routine inspections occur monthly.

[HOSTEL LAUNDRY FACILITIES & TIMINGS] (hostel): Washing machine facilities are accessible in Block A and Block B basement from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Students can request laundry tokens at the warden's desk. Clothes drying is allowed only in designated balcony areas.

[HOSTEL NIGHT OUT PASS PROCEDURE] (hostel): Students requesting weekend night out passes must submit their request on the student portal or warden office before 5:00 PM on Friday. Parent approval via SMS/Call is verified before issuing passes.

[MID-SEMESTER EXAMINATION SCHEDULE NOTICE] (college): Mid-Semester examinations for B.Tech Semester 3 and 5 will commence from October 15th to October 22nd. Detailed timetable and room seating allocations will be published on the main department notice board.

[DIWALI FESTIVAL HOLIDAY NOTICE] (college): The college campus, central library, and administrative offices will remain closed for Diwali holidays from November 1st to November 5th. Regular academic classes will resume on November 6th at 9:00 AM.

[SEMESTER TUITION FEE PAYMENT DEADLINE] (college): The final deadline for odd-semester tuition and exam fee submission is September 30th. Payments can be completed online via the ERP portal. Late fee penalty of Rs. 100 per day applies thereafter.

[CENTRAL LIBRARY RULES & BOOK ISSUE LIMIT] (college): The Central Library is open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on weekdays. Undergraduate students can borrow up to 4 books for 14 days. Overdue fines are charged at Rs. 5 per day per book.

metadata.title: Central Library Rules & Book Issue Limit

text: [FAQ: HOW TO APPLY FOR HOSTEL ROOM TRANSFER] (hostel): To request a room transfer or change roommates, collect the Hostel Transfer Form from the Warden Office, obtain signatures from both room residents, and submit it during office hours (2:00 PM - 5:00 PM).

metadata.title: FAQ: How to Apply for Hostel Room Transfer

text: [FAQ: HOW TO REPORT MAINTENANCE ISSUES IN HOSTEL] (hostel): To report electrical, plumbing, or carpenter maintenance issues in your room, log a complaint in the Hostel Maintenance Register located at the hostel security guard desk, or submit an online ticket.

metadata.title: FAQ: How to Report Maintenance Issues in Hostel

text: [FAQ: CAMPUS SPORTS FACILITIES ACCESS] (college): Students can access the gymnasium, basketball court, and badminton arena using their student ID card between 6:00 AM - 8:30 AM and 4:30 PM - 8:00 PM daily. Equipment borrowing requires ID deposit.

[B.TECH COMPUTER SCIENCE SEMESTER 3 TIMETABLE] (college): CS Sem 3 Weekly Timetable: Monday & Wednesday 9:00 AM - Data Structures Lecture (Room 201), 11:00 AM - Operating Systems (Room 203), 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM - Object Oriented Programming Lab (Lab 3). Tuesday & Thursday 10:00 AM - Discrete Mathematics.

[DATA STRUCTURES & ALGORITHMS SYLLABUS] (college): CS201 Data Structures Syllabus: Unit 1: Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues. Unit 2: Binary Trees, BST, AVL Trees. Unit 3: Graph Representations, BFS, DFS, Dijkstra's algorithm. Unit 4: Sorting & Hashing (QuickSort, MergeSort, Hash Tables).
[ANNUAL SPORTS MEET 2026 GUIDELINES] (college): Students interested in participating in the annual track & field events must register at the sports complex before September 5th.
[EMERGENCY HOSTEL WATER PIPELINE REPAIR] (hostel): Hostel Block A and B water supply will be interrupted between 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM today.
[URGENT HOD ACADEMIC AUDIT MEETING] (college): All Department HODs are requested to attend the confidential budget meeting at 11 AM.
